target: iPhone 16 Pro Max · iPhone17,2 · Apple A18 Pro
scope: Public specifications and a third-party public benchmark. S2Arm inputs are synthetic. Absolute game FPS, energy and sustainable throughput are uncalibrated.

cpu.dispatch_constraint: Check build target and runtime availability before issuing optional instructions. A device report establishes neither OS state-management support in every context nor a throughput.

public_device_sample.cache_scope: The report lists each field once and does not identify its CPU cluster. These values do not establish per-cluster geometries, associativity, latency, cache line size or the system-level cache.

memory.model: Shared backing memory, Metal shared/private/memoryless modes have distinct visibility and lifetimes.
memory.allocation_headroom: iOS process headroom varies. Query os_proc_available_memory where available. Track resource peaks, allocator reuse and process footprint separately.

constraints: Check device support for the specific feature and OS API before choosing a path.
Count live attachment data across pass boundaries. Logical bytes precede on-chip retention and compression; exact DRAM traffic is unknown.
Derive SIMD execution width and threadgroup limits from the device and pipeline.
Test vectorized, FP16 and SIMD changes against bit-exact synthetic results before retaining them.

neural_engine.execution: Core ML can allow the OS to select available compute units, including the Neural Engine. There is no established S2Arm draw-to-ANE mapping; benchmark a specific model and output equivalence before assigning any benefit.

analytical_cost_model.units: per fixed synthetic workload, never per game frame unless a frame workload is actually measured
analytical_cost_model.stream_lower_bound_s: required_offchip_bytes / peak_bytes_per_second; valid only with justified bytes and peak
analytical_cost_model.overlap: For a compute stage and a transfer stage with fixed costs and no other delays, the idealized bounds are max(Tcompute,Ttransfer) and Tcompute+Ttransfer. Fences, queue stalls and extra work must be measured separately.
analytical_cost_model.identifiability: Host Ir and cache misses refer only to the measured/simulated host ISA and cache configuration. There is no calibrated conversion to A18 Pro instructions or latency. Missing parameters imply an unbounded projection, not a zero cost.
analytical_cost_model.uncertainty: Provide both endpoints when sweeping positive input ranges. Scenario endpoints express assumptions, not a statistical confidence interval. Estimate sampling variability separately from paired repetitions.
calibration_needed: dynamic target instruction count or equivalent arm64 counter
transfer bytes after compression and concurrency
